'''R2-X2''' was a [[Color|green]] and white<ref name="Disney Infinity">''[[Disney Infinity 3.0]]''</ref> [[R2-series astromech droid]] that served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Yavin]], it was at the Alliance's headquarters within the [[Great Temple]] on the [[moon]] of [[Yavin 4]] and attended a briefing by [[General]] [[Jan Dodonna]] on the Alliance's plans to attack the Imperial [[Death Star]] [[superweapon]]. R2-X2 was then later loaded into the [[astromech socket]] of a [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]] in the temple's hangar bay which soon launched as part of [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadron]] to destroy the Death Star.<ref name="ANH" /> It flew with [[Theron Nett]] as [[Red Ten]]<ref name="Black Series">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Black Series|pack=Red Squadron|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/Red-Squadron-Star-Wars-The-Black-Series-Hasbro.asp}}</ref> but both were [[Death|killed]] when their [[X-wing starfighter]] was shot down.<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
R2-X2 first appeared in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> The droid was then first identified on a card in the "[[Premiere Limited]]" set of the ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]'' released in [[1995]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=R2-X2}}</ref> The name was then first used in [[canon]] by the Japanese [[Wikipedia:Gashapon|gacha]] toy ''[[Star Wars Pullback Droid]]'' when it was released in [[June]] [[2015]].<ref name="Pullback">''[[Star Wars Pullback Droid]]''</ref>
